The name "Uoc Mo Xanh" not only evokes the lush greenery of the trees and the lake's surface, but also conveys the sense of a tranquil oasis amidst the city's hustle and bustle.

As one approaches the site, the eye is drawn to the clusters of colorful tents scattered under the shade of tall trees, their vibrant hues a stark contrast to the surrounding urban landscape. The vast lawns and the large lake, with its gentle ripples, dominate the scene, creating a sense of serenity and calm.
